title: Unique strongboxes with Jado
summary: Jado's Trove Seekers doubles the chance for strongboxes to be unique and Stolen Relics adds the Twilight Reliquary Key box; Overseer tablets, The Chosen Path and Overlord's Influence add more strongboxes.

budget.why: One magic Overseer Tablet and waystones rolled for item rarity only.
budget.build_needs: Survives strongbox guard packs and their strongbox modifiers.

claim.note: Our reading of the setup against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: Opening a strongbox unleashes its guard packs, which strongbox modifiers can make Rare or give extra monster modifiers.

claim.note: Our reading of the cited facts against the build scale; not measured.

complexity.why: Open every strongbox, then decide which ones to reopen with a Cryptic Key — a choice in the map.

claim.note: Our reading of the strategy's own steps against the complexity scale; not measured.

yields.why: Stolen Relics: Unique Strongboxes may be the Legacy of the Order, which contains 1 additional Twilight Reliquary Key.
Mysterious Gifts: Rare Strongbox Monsters have 5% chance to drop a Cryptic Key.

nodes.name: Trove Seekers
nodes.effect: 100% increased amount of Rare Chests; Strongboxes have 100% increased chance to be Unique

nodes.name: Mysterious Gifts
nodes.effect: Unique Monsters have 1% chance to drop a Cryptic Key; Rare Strongbox Monsters have 5% chance to drop a Cryptic Key

nodes.name: Stolen Relics
nodes.effect: Unique Strongboxes may be the Legacy of the Order, dropping a Twilight Reliquary Key

atlas_master.alt: Doryani T3 Mechanical Guardians: non-unique strongboxes are guarded by a dormant Construct and have 2% increased Item Quantity per Modifier.

claim.note: All three nodes name strongboxes directly (poe2db); the combination is our synthesis. Not measured. T4 Keen Appraisal is our pick: the only Jado T4 node that adds general loot on any map (Untold Histories adds lineage).

atlas_passives.name: The Chosen Path
atlas_passives.effect: 100% increased chance of a certain content type — take Strongboxes

atlas_passives.name: Overlord's Influence
atlas_passives.effect: Add additional content to areas with Powerful Map Bosses — options: an additional Strongbox, Shrine or Azmeri Spirit. Take Strongboxes.

atlas_passives.name: Hidden Compartments
atlas_passives.effect: Strongboxes have 15% chance to be openable twice

atlas_passives.name: An Appropriate Vault
atlas_passives.effect: Strongboxes have 2% increased Item Quantity per Modifier

atlas_passives.name: Ghastly Relics
atlas_passives.effect: Large Abyssal Chests from Abyss Pits are instead an Abyssal Strongbox

claim.note: Only on maps with Abysses; see the Abyss strategy. 0.5.5 extended it to all Large Abyssal Chests from Pits.

Suffix 'of Compartments' (Overseer only; stat maps_with_powerful_bosses_additional_strongbox_+). 3040603554's other text, 'Areas with Powerful Map Bosses contain an additional Strongbox', is this stat in RePoE; its Map text is the one-Strongbox wording. Corrected 2026-09-30: was 3240183538, which is map_num_extra_strongboxes.

mods.text: Map has (70–100)% increased chance to contain Strongboxes

claim.note: Suffix 'of the Antiquarian' (stat map_num_extra_strongboxes); rolls on any tablet base. 3240183538's other text, 'Area contains an additional Strongbox', is this stat in RePoE; its Map text is the '# additional Strongboxes' wording. Corrected 2026-09-30: was 3040603554, the Powerful Map Boss stat.

waystone.notes: Strongbox contents are rolled by the box; map item rarity is an assumed, unmeasured bonus.

claim.note: Unverified. The waystone rarity line reads 'more Rarity of Items found in this Area' (RePoE), but strongbox contents have their own rarity sources (Ornate and Possessed Strongboxes on poe2db; 0.5.0's 'more Rarity of Contained Items' strongbox prefixes) and poe2db counts strongbox monsters as not naturally spawning. No source says whether the map total multiplies strongbox contents; test in game.

steps: Set Jado: Trove Seekers, Mysterious Gifts, Stolen Relics, Keen Appraisal.
Allocate The Chosen Path and Overlord's Influence on Strongboxes, then Hidden Compartments.
Slot an Overseer Tablet with additional strongboxes or strongbox chance; the 'of the Antiquarian' strongbox and the chance mod also roll on any tablet.
Open every strongbox; use Cryptic Keys to reopen the good ones.
risks: Unique strongbox contents are random (for example Ixchel's Torment grants a corrupted unique); the basket prices only the keys.
Overlord's Influence adds content only where the Map Boss is Powerful.
Whether 'of Compartments' requires a Powerful Map Boss is unverified (RePoE names its stat maps_with_powerful_bosses_additional_strongbox_+, the same family as 'of Crystals').
